explanation: Matches Conjecture 0.6 of arXiv:math/0703548: commutative domain R, group G, g with infinite order or finite order not invertible in R; then HS_RG(P) vanishes at (g) for f.g. projective P. Lean reformulates P as an idempotent matrix, which is equivalent since every f.g. projective is the image of one (n may be an arbitrary Fintype). The trace sums diagonal coefficients over the class of g, which is the definition of the rank, and orderOf=0 handles infinite order.
